purpose: follow a single request through many services to find where time is spent and where it fails
entry_criteria: Services are instrumented or can be
procedure: Adopt one propagation standard so the trace context passes through every call, including queues and background jobs.
Instrument inbound and outbound calls, database queries and key internal operations with meaningful span names.
Add useful attributes (route, status, tenant class) and keep sensitive data out of spans.
Set a sampling policy: always keep errors and slow requests, sample the rest, and state the cost.
Link traces with logs and metrics through the trace id.
Verify by tracing a real request across services and checking that no hop is missing.
acceptance_criteria: A request shows all hops, including asynchronous ones
Errors and slow requests are always retained

validation.check: send one request and open its trace
validation.expect: spans for gateway, services and database appear in order

validation.check: search a log line by the trace id from that request

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A checkout request traces through the gateway, order service, payment adapter and database. The trace shows 800 of 950 ms spent waiting on the payment provider, and the trace id links to the log lines of each service.
